original_query: Do most buyers type the URL address directly into Internet or use a search engine every visit?

summaries.found_via_query: What percentage of internet users type URLs directly versus using search engines for most visits?
summaries.summary: The infographic shows that 55% of auto buyers type the URL directly into the internet, while only 21% use a search engine every time before visiting the site. Among those who use search engines, 42% searched on the internet, and 58% used other methods. Of those who learned from ads, 47% saw it on TV.
key_facts: 55% typed web address directly into Internet
Only 21% used a search engine every time before visiting the site
47% of those who first learned from ads saw it on TV
